title: Partnership Director
status: Official employer-hosted posting available 2026-11-09; reconfirm before applying
source: Lemnis/Lever employer job listing checked 2026-11-09; candidate-created analytical work sample; no employer data accessed
headline: Partner retention measured through institutional outcomes
thesis: Build a portfolio-wide partner success and renewal system for higher-education institutions: stakeholder mapping, leading health indicators, measurable student engagement, executive business reviews and risk-reviewed renewal forecasts.
requirements: Own partner retention and renewals across assigned institutional portfolio
Map executive and operational stakeholders and institutional goals
Lead executive business reviews with evidence of partner impact
Monitor partner health, gross revenue retention, and renewal risk
Coordinate expansion with Sales and implementation handoffs
Coach assigned Partner Operations Managers and maintain CRM records
phases: Interview partner stakeholders; define contracted outcomes, account ownership, and renewal risk
Institutional account maps, renewal calendar, baseline health scorecard
Build segment-specific QBR templates and intervention playbooks with the Sales and Operations teams
Executive review packs, retention risk triage and measurable partnership impact
Pilot account reviews and forecast renewals; assess expansion only when partner value is evidenced
90-day renewal forecast, risk register, partner success operating cadence

employer_needs.need: Protect renewal revenue across a portfolio of institutional partners
employer_needs.prototype_feature: Institutional renewal risk register with stakeholder coverage, renewal calendar and intervention choices
employer_needs.success_metric: Gross revenue retention, forecast confidence and at-risk partner resolution
employer_needs.candidate_fit: Reported multi-site education operations, recurring enrollment retention and partner relationship experience transfer to portfolio reviews; higher-education renewal ownership still requires validation
employer_needs.open_question: Which renewals, data access and partner segments would be in scope for the first quarter?

employer_needs.need: Prove partnership value against individual college and university priorities
employer_needs.prototype_feature: Executive business review module tracing institutional objective to adoption evidence and outcome claim
employer_needs.success_metric: Percent of accounts with jointly agreed outcome measures and on-time executive reviews
employer_needs.candidate_fit: Experience communicating student outcomes and school-program performance supports structured value reporting; institution-specific product benchmarks not yet known
employer_needs.open_question: Which student-success measures do institutional sponsors trust most?

employer_needs.need: Coordinate Sales expansion and coach Partner Operations Managers without losing ownership
employer_needs.prototype_feature: Responsibility matrix and cross-functional escalation/expansion decision ledger
employer_needs.success_metric: Handoff completeness, issue-resolution timeliness and qualified expansion opportunities
employer_needs.candidate_fit: Reported staff leadership and school partnership experience are relevant; direct Mainstay operations and CRM experience not established
employer_needs.open_question: How are ownership and account escalation currently split among POMs, Sales, Implementation and Product?
